decision.reason: [ev-e660cc3b05ab] and [ev-d319547c1a11] are the same CHANGELOG line, repeated. All it says is that the v3.0 branch was merged into master, with a link to PR #10418. It names no product subject, no before/after behaviour or change type, and no operational effect. A branch merge like this likely bundles several unnamed changes, so the PR contents or the individual changes inside it are needed before anyone can write the subject, change, applicability or consequence.
